set.body:
Objective
Implement row-group sparsity and a nonnegative smooth support envelope g with norm(A_v) <= g_v, graph-TV on g, and separately tuned optional signed-loading smoothness.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements PAT-02, FND-03, PERF-01, NUM-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
numerical implementation; pattern spatial regularizer; mvpa-spatial graph adapters; Gale generic proximal capabilities. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M3.02, M1.03. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Coherent support can retain checkerboard positive/negative loadings; smoothing support does not force identical neighboring signs.
2. Cortical surface adjacency and subcortical volume graphs preserve topology, units and weights; no unintended links across sulci.
3. Conditional convex subproblems pass small independent constraint/objective oracles and report feasibility tolerances.
4. Generic proximal/optimization capability belongs upstream; graph sweeps are portable, sparse and allocation-budgeted.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaSpatialJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaSpatialJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.04: Implement sparse spatial support envelopes with separately controlled signed smoothing
